subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The__ camouflage__ look of army tanks saves them from enemy attack.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Exhibit)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"camouflage"** means the act of concealing or disguising something to blend in with the surroundings and avoid detection. (छिपाना/छलावरण)

 
 
• **Example:** The chameleon uses its ability to change colors as a natural form of camouflage.
 
 
 
• **"Exhibit"** refers to making something visible or putting it on display, which is the opposite of concealing or disguising. (प्रदर्शित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The museum will exhibit rare artifacts from ancient civilizations.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"camouflage"** is **"exhibit."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Exhibit)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Veiled** (ढका हुआ): Covered, hidden, or concealed.

 
 
• **Example:** Her veiled comments suggested she was unhappy with the decision.
 
 
 
• **Disguised** (भेष बदलना): To change appearance or hide identity.
 
 
• **Example:** The detective disguised himself as a common man to gather information.
 
 
 
• **Obscure** (अस्पष्ट): Not clearly expressed or easily understood; hidden or concealed.
 
 
• **Example:** The meaning of the old manuscript was obscure to modern readers.
 
 

32:Tc84,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
